title: Manufacturing and Selling Spurious Goods Causing Injury

content.scenario: A company in Mumbai manufactured and sold spurious baby food that caused non-grievous hurt to several infants. The company's actions were found to be in violation of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.
content.outcome: The company may be punished with imprisonment for a term which may extend to one year and with a fine which may extend to three lakh rupees, as per Section 91(1) of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.

user_queries: What is the punishment for selling spurious goods?
Can a company be imprisoned for selling fake products?
What are the consequences of causing non-grievous hurt to consumers?
